Available in this sample set: {{SAMPLE_CHARS}} Each @font-face rule carries a unicode-range limited to those characters, so anything else (for example é $ ₹ ; ( )) falls through to the system serif face instead of {{FAMILY}}. The font's own .notdef is empty and is never shown.
